decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry under Features [ev-916bf6975201]. It says the PodLog CRD API version is now configurable in the Helm chart, but not what the default is or whether it differs from the API version the chart rendered before. So the claim that "environments that do not use this option are unaffected" goes beyond what the evidence states. Deciding between none and behavior-change needs the commit diff or values.yaml for d1dee91 (#10812), showing the new values key and its default compared with the previously hard-coded PodLog apiVersion.
